category_policy.description: Vocabulary groups describe everyday topics and areas of life, not source, book, photograph, level or import batch. Part-of-speech and catch-all labels are omitted from this reviewed batch; original labels remain in the audit and untouched original backups.
category_policy.function_words: Language and Grammar covers language function words. It is a topic about language rather than an invented life-domain assignment.
category_policy.assignments: Manual assistant review of meaning and available source expression context. Words may have multiple thematic categories.
category_policy.new_groups: New thematic group names are prepared locally only; importer will create them when authorized to import.

enrichment_provenance.translations: Unchanged from the earliest occurrence in photo batches 01–05. Different source-batch field values retained in source_field_variants, rather than silently overwritten or lost.
enrichment_provenance.levels: Earliest assistant CEFR estimate retained; variants recorded.
enrichment_provenance.groups: Assistant thematic review of all records; explicit supplemental assignments for the 430 word forms previously having only generic/grammatical labels.
enrichment_provenance.progress: No database or learner progress accessed or changed.
